subject: Mosaic Systems: Consulting Onboarding Pilot — training & triage plan
messages:
From: Elena Park <elena.park@mosaicsys.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood pilot + SI training ask

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Mosaic Systems is excited about the integration patterns you showed for low-latency retrieval and model routing. Our consulting arm (BrightFrame) will lead the implementation for our first enterprise customer and they asked for a short enablement pilot before we commit to a scoped SOW.

High-level ask: can Redwood run a 3-session pilot with our lead SI (BrightFrame) covering:
- architecture triage (top 3 integration risks for Mosaic use-cases)
- hands-on runtime configuration (batching, cache patterns, canary routing)
- training for BrightFrame engineers and a short joint-runbook review

Tentative dates: week of June 19. We can share a short list of customer workloads and sample prompts ahead of time.

I attached a short list of onboarding topics and a draft SOW to speed review.

Appreciate any guidance on format and pricing (pilot/credits or time-and-materials).

Best,
Elena Park
Director, Partnerships — Mosaic Systems
elena.park@mosaicsys.com
[attachment: Mosaic_Onboard_Topics.pdf (pdf), Mosaic_SOW_Draft.docx (docx)]

From: michael_grant@redwood.ai <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena.park@mosaicsys.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 01 Jun 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot + SI training ask

Elena — thanks for the clear ask and the materials. Looping in Laura (Partner Success) and Grace (Solutions Engineering) to scope the pilot. Quick thoughts:

- We typically run a 3-workshop format (triage, hands-on lab, runbook + cutover checklist) and can compress to three half-days if BrightFrame prefers.
- For pricing: we can offer up to 8 engineer-hours pro-bono for discovery, then either a credits-backed pilot (recommended for small PoCs) or a T&M SOW for full delivery.
- Needed from Mosaic before we finalize: 1) sample workload (token distribution + RPS), 2) access plan for test sandbox, 3) list of BrightFrame engineers and their roles.

Laura — can you own scheduling and the pilot pack (templates and facilitator list)? Grace — can you confirm SE availability the week of June 19 and whether we should prepare a sandbox snapshot for the lab?

Elena, I can commit to being the executive sponsor and will join the triage workshop.

Thanks,

Michael Grant
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference for production

> Hi Michael —
>
> Thanks again for the demo last week....

Thanks all — Ravi here from BrightFrame. We appreciate the proposed format. A couple of clarifications from our side:

1) Scope: the customer wants the pilot to cover both streaming-chat flows and embeddings-backed retrieval fallback. We'll bring 2 engineers to the lab and one architect to the triage.
2) Outcomes: we need a short checklist we can hand to the customer's infra team to stand up the test sandbox (VPC peering checklist, KMS notes, and sample load patterns).
3) Timing: week of June 19 works if Redwood can commit to SE time on June 20–22 (Wed–Fri).

Also, small ask on contract path: can Redwood share a minimal SOW template and a pilot acceptance criteria doc we can use to speed procurement?

Attached: small BrightFrame intake (just emails) — we can provide engineer resumes if you want.

Rgds,
Ravi Singh
Principal Consultant, BrightFrame Consulting
ravi@brightframe.com

Elena / Ravi — great, thank you. I will: 

- Draft a one-page pilot SOW and a one-page acceptance criteria doc (deliverables + exit criteria) and circulate by Monday (June 4).
- Prep a sandbox checklist (VPC peering, KMS, service accounts, sample load script) and link a Drive folder with templates: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mosaic_onboard
- Confirm SEs: Grace and Marcus are available June 20–22. We will run the triage (half day) on June 20, hands-on labs June 21, runbook + acceptance review June 22.
- Provide an initial facilitator pack (slides + lab exercises) and a short pre-work packet the BrightFrame engineers can complete the week before.

Elena: can you send the token distribution and a short red-team list of failure scenarios (e.g., region failover, cold-start spikes) by COB Monday? That will help Grace shape the lab exercises.

Ravi: please send the two engineer names and their email addresses; we'll add them to the Drive folder and share access.

I'll attach the draft SOW when I send Monday's pack. If this plan looks good, I'll also open a HubSpot record for the pilot (HS-98765) and tag this thread.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
